name: ToggleButtonGroup
summary: Toggles one or more related actions as a group.

useWhen: Switching between related modes or options that apply as soon as they are chosen, such as text alignment or a view mode
Toggling several related options independently, with multiple selection
avoidWhen: Choosing a named option to submit with a form; use RadioGroup
Choosing several named options to submit with a form; use CheckboxGroup

behavior: Arrow keys move through grouped toggles.
Selection is either controlled by the application or managed by the component.
selectedIds and defaultSelectedIds are arrays of the string ids of the child ToggleButtons, so give each ToggleButton a stable id.
selectionMode is single or multiple, and any other value throws a TypeError.
A single-selection group holds at most one id, and an array with more throws a TypeError.
The all value is not accepted for selectedIds or defaultSelectedIds, and onSelectionChange receives the selected ids as an array of strings.
When disallowEmptySelection is true, an active selection cannot be cleared.
Interactive control sizes use the shared sm, md, and lg targets; md is the default.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
